June 26 UTC close ($62,000 gate test) is the next binary event.

## Technical analysis

**June 25 UTC candle (Crypto.com verified):** Open $61,079.86 / High $61,967.01 / Low $58,100.00 / Close $59,795.45. Volume 4,321 BTC ($258.4M).

**Non-participation:** The session high of $61,967 was reached during the US premarket risk-on session but was $33 below the $62,000 gate. BTC then sold off after the US market close to $58,100 — a post-close continuation of the distribution pattern.

**Re-entry clock:** NOT activated. Two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 required. June 25 close $59,795 is −$2,205 below the gate. Gap to close = +3.7%.

**Next binary event:** June 26 UTC close at 20:00 UTC. Scenario A: close above $62,000 → Day 1 activated. Scenario B: close below $60,000 → structural support breach, next target $57,500–$58,500.
